verses.original: שִׁ֥יר הַֽמַּעֲל֗וֹת לְדָ֫וִ֥ד הִנֵּ֣ה מַה־ טּ֭וֹב וּמַה־ נָּעִ֑ים גַּם־ אַחִ֣ים שֶׁ֖בֶת יָֽחַד׃
verses.transliteration: šîr ham·ma·‘ă·lō·wṯ lə·ḏā·wiḏ hin·nêh mah- ṭō·wḇ ū·mah- nā·‘îm gam- ’a·ḥîm še·ḇeṯ yā·ḥaḏ
verses.literal: A song of ascents Of David Behold how good and pleasant it is when brothers live together in harmony

verses.original: הַטּ֨וֹב׀ כַּשֶּׁ֤מֶן עַל־ הָרֹ֗אשׁ יֹרֵ֗ד עַֽל־ הַזָּקָ֥ן שֶׁ֝יֹּרֵ֗ד אַהֲרֹ֑ן זְקַֽן־ עַל־ פִּ֥י מִדּוֹתָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: haṭ·ṭō·wḇ kaš·še·men ‘al- hā·rōš yō·rêḏ ‘al- haz·zā·qān šey·yō·rēd̲ ’a·hă·rōn zə·qan- ‘al- pî mid·dō·w·ṯāw
verses.literal: It is like fine oil on the head running down on the beard running down Aaron’s beard over the collar of his robes

verses.original: כְּטַל־ חֶרְמ֗וֹן שֶׁיֹּרֵד֮ עַל־ הַרְרֵ֪י צִ֫יּ֥וֹן כִּ֤י שָׁ֨ם׀ יְ֭הוָה אֶת־ צִוָּ֣ה הַבְּרָכָ֑ה חַ֝יִּ֗ים עַד־ הָעוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kə·ṭal- ḥer·mō·wn še·yō·rêḏ ‘al- har·rê ṣî·yō·wn kî šām Yah·weh ’eṯ- ṣiw·wāh hab·bə·rā·ḵāh ḥay·yîm ‘aḏ- hā·‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: It is like the dew of Hermon falling on the mountains of Zion For there the LORD - has bestowed the blessing of life forevermore . . .
